principle: Owner/family-first. Hard technical gates override weighted aesthetics.
hard_gates: No construction approval while structural_status is TBD for altered walls/openings.
No developed open-kitchen option without a feasible gas/extraction/ventilation route or a separately approved appliance strategy.
No unresolved severe appliance/door operating collision.
No new primary-route clearance below the project 750 mm review threshold without an explicit justified exception.
No façade/shaft/riser/common-service change without authority/developer approval.
No wet-area change without waterproofing/drainage/service coordination.
scoring: Each category 1..5; weighted score normalized to 100. Render appearance is evidence for spatial review only and cannot clear hard gates.
